stimuli.text:
Lake Wilson is a small lake in upstate New York. Each summer, a few dozen families move into small cottages near the lake for the season. The vacationers enjoy boating, swimming, and fishing in the lake and they've gotten to know each other over the course of many summers together.
Most people who like to fish in Lake Wilson catch a few fish each day and cook them for dinner. These people buy their fishing gear from a small tackle shop on the main road. Up until now, the tackle shop has sold one kind of fishing hook. But it has recently starting selling a new kind of hook that allows people to catch many more fish than they would with the older hook.
There are 20 people who regularly fish in Lake Wilson during the summer. If 7 or more people started using the new hook for fishing, then by the end of the summer, the entire fish population would collapse and there would be no more fish in Lake Wilson ever again. None of the vacationers would want that to happen. However, up to 4 people can use the new hooks with no decrease at all in the size and health of the fish population. Those people will be able to catch more fish more quickly, everyone else will still be able to catch the same amount of fish as before, and the fish population would continue to be exactly as large and as healthy as in past years.
